0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, on a three-game winning streak) host the Jazz (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak) in Minnesota's 11th game of the season, with Minnesota second in the Northwest, one game back, and Utah fifth, 6.5 games back. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points per game this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Minnesota won the last meeting 147-111 in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026, and took the 2025-26 season series 3-1.
